title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Frozen Mango Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Frozen Mango is a tropical dream in vape form, with the bold, juicy flavour of fresh Mangoes blended with crushed Ice for an invigoratingly cool and fruity all-day vape. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
